note: Masses are catalogue values; the printed-parts mass comes from the CAD files. Weigh each part as you build and update this file; the sizing page and the docs are generated from it.

items.name: Brushless motor 2810, about 1100 KV
items.spec: 28xx outrunner, 4S rated 40 A, M3 mount 16 x 16 or 19 x 19 mm, Ø5 mm shaft
items.notes: Mounted upside down under the hub plate, shaft down. Static thrust is measured on the thrust stand at Gate 1.

items.name: Propeller 10 x 4.5 two-blade, pusher type (mounted)
items.spec: 10 inch (254 mm), reverse-pitch (pusher) for the rotation direction of the motor
items.notes: The prop hangs below the motor and blows air down through the vanes: it must be a pusher type.

items.name: Spare propellers 10 x 4.5 pusher
items.spec: Same rotation as the mounted prop

items.name: ESC 40 A, 4S, BLHeli_S / AM32, PWM 400 Hz
items.spec: Single ESC, standard 1000 to 2000 us signal
items.notes: Mounted on the electronics deck in the intake airflow.

items.name: LiPo 4S 1500 mAh, 75C+, XT60
items.spec: 14.8 V nominal, about 75 x 35 x 34 mm
items.notes: Check size: it must fit 75 x 35 x 35 mm between the strap slots.

items.name: Servo BEC 6.0 V / 5 A
items.spec: Switching regulator, 4S input
items.notes: Powers the four servos only. Never from the ESC.

items.name: Logic BEC 5 V / 3 A
items.spec: Switching regulator, 4S input
items.notes: Powers the ESP32 board and the buzzer.

items.name: Power leads, XT60 pair, 14 AWG silicone
Arming switch + remove-before-flight loop
items.spec: Switch in the battery lead or on the deck
items.notes: Remove the loop to cut the battery lead before any work near the prop.

items.name: Battery voltage divider 47 k / 10 k + 100 nF
items.spec: Divides the pack voltage to 3 V at full charge for the ESP32 ADC
items.notes: Check with a multimeter before connecting the ADC pin.

items.name: ESP32-S3 development board (DevKitC-1 class), Wi-Fi access point and controller
items.spec: 3.3 V logic, LEDC PWM outputs, hardware UART
items.notes: Serves the phone control page on its own network (MC1-FLY, http://192.168.4.1/). Pins in firmware/monocopter/include/pins.h.

items.name: ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz receiver (optional radio link, not used by the phone firmware)
items.spec: 5 V, UART at 420000 baud, CRSF output
items.notes: Only if you swap the phone link for a radio (docs/phase1-monocopter/05-firmware-and-control.md section 8). Not fitted in the baseline.

items.name: Buzzer + status LEDs
items.spec: Active buzzer 5 V, 2 LEDs with resistors

items.name: Micro servo, metal gear, digital, 9 to 12 g
items.spec: About 23 x 12 x 24 mm, 25T spline, 3 kg.cm or more, 6 V
items.notes: Drives the vane directly through a horn adapter.

items.name: Spare servo
items.spec: Same model

items.name: Vane rod Ø3 x 116 mm, steel or carbon
items.spec: Straight, deburred
items.notes: Cut from a 3 mm rod; epoxy into the vane and into the horn adapter.

items.name: Printed parts, 45 pieces (PETG, TPU feet)
items.spec: hardware/cad/mc1-monocopter-stl.zip, list in docs/phase1-monocopter/printable-parts.md
items.notes: Mass is 65 % of the solid mass of the 40 pieces that are mounted (688 g solid; the two spare vanes and the part count in the file list are not counted); weigh the real parts.

items.name: M3 screws and nuts, M2 self-tap screws
items.spec: Stainless; counts in docs/phase1-monocopter/printable-parts.md

items.name: M3 brass heat-set inserts
items.spec: Ø4.2 hole, 5.7 mm long
items.notes: 7 per post (top, two for the stator, four for the ring tabs) and 4 per servo cradle.

items.name: M3 standoffs, female-female, 39 mm
items.spec: Aluminium or nylon
items.notes: Between the hub plate and the electronics deck.

items.name: Battery strap 20 mm Velcro (2) + foam pad
Wire 26-30 AWG silicone, zip ties, heat shrink
Thrust stand: 5 kg load cell + HX711
items.spec: Measures static thrust and power

items.name: Tether kit: 3 x 3 m line, ground anchors, swivel
Polycarbonate shield or net cage
items.notes: Between the prop and anyone nearby.

items.name: Current-limited bench supply or smoke stopper
LiPo safe bag + balance charger
Phone with a browser (any recent Android or iPhone)
items.spec: Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz; keep the screen on during flight
